1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.Nf3 b6 4.Nc3 d5 5.cxd.strategy: Pins the f6 knight against the queen at once, while Black has not yet developed the rest of the pieces. Black has to spend a move to unravel the pin, and White keeps the pressure on d5 and e4.

Answers the pin by developing the bishop behind the knight and preparing to castle. Black keeps a solid position with a pawn on d5 against White's pressure, though the pieces stay somewhat passive until they find squares.
